name: FinalizeImportRunReview
transaction_boundary: one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork containing final run state, checkpoint/recovery event, optional chronology-eligible reappearance enqueue, audit and result
authoritative_reads: latest exact recovery authorization when applicable
for advanced_search_sr recovery, exact run/checkpoint chronology and whether this finalization replaces the checkpoint logical population
guards: run is staged|waiting_review or authorized recovery_required
OLDER_SOURCE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED never decrements/replaces the higher checkpoint and never becomes automatic source-presence freshness authority
CHRONOLOGY_CONTENT_CONFLICT may schedule reappearance only when this exact authorized finalization replaces the source checkpoint at the same chronology
receipt_order: revalidate/no-change -> insert receipt -> checkpoint/recovery-event/run writes -> if advanced_search_sr equal-chronology correction became the exact replacement checkpoint, enqueue_or_coalesce ticket_import.sr_reappearance_reconcile for this run in the same UoW -> ticket_import.run_finalized.v1 + result -> commit
mutations: LLD-01 durable job enqueue only for finalized equal-chronology advanced_search_sr correction that becomes current checkpoint authority
revision_effects: run revision increments once; checkpoint revision increments only when changed; older recovery never decrements or replaces higher chronology
post_commit_work: NEW_SOURCE reappearance work was already scheduled atomically by publication. Equal-chronology advanced_search_sr correction schedules its run-keyed reappearance job only when authorized finalization replaces the checkpoint. Older recovery schedules none.
